The answer correctly identifies the vendor (often a manufacturer) as responsible for maintaining the agreed-upon product level at the customer's location, matching the page-62 passage verbatim.

The answer states forecast accuracy decreases and uncertainty grows as the horizon lengthens, directly matching assumption 3 in the page-36 passage and the reference.

The answer gives the textbook definitions of trend (consistent directional movement) and seasonality (predictable recurring annual changes), matching the reference's core distinction; the climate/holiday elaboration is supported by the causal-forecasting passage, and omitting the cycle/irregular contrast is minor.

The three listed inputs — kind of capacity, how much, and when — match the page-119 passage and the reference exactly.

The answer correctly states that a gap exists when infrastructure (e.g., power) restoration time objectives exceed how long the node can run on backup without significant operational impact, matching the page-17 passage and the node-versus-infrastructure distinction.
